integrity: The finite quotient flag complexes, stabilizer-sensitive orbit counts, and elementary collapses are fully reproduced by the included standalone Python checker and its recorded output.
scientific_limitations: Only the compact Abrams cubical discretized two-particle space for the pentagonal wheel is classified. No unproved equivariant extension to unrestricted continuous configuration spaces or general wheels is claimed. The full text of a relevant later wheel symmetry-character result was inaccessible; independent novelty review remains necessary.
title: Integral homotopy classification of all dihedral-subgroup quotients of pentagonal-wheel two-particle configurations
